capability: Deterministic dual-source citation-ledger audit runtime. evaluate_source_ledger loads the compile-time-embedded facts.json (83 cited constants across coating-industry technical references, 23 marked load_bearing) and source_records.json (162 source records with 26 required per-record fields including retrieved-date, revision_date, url_status, license_use_limit, candidate_grade, supplier_status, PFAS/TSCA/TAA compliance, numeric-value comparison, extraction-status, authority URL). Independently counts cited constants, load-bearing constants, two-source-corroborated (non-empty second_url), prose-waived (non-empty single_source_waiver), missing-URL, source records, and incomplete records. Returns status='FAILED_GATES' with score=0.0 because 14 load-bearing constants lack a second controlled source and 14 prose waivers exist. Gates uncited_constants_rejected=true (0 missing URLs), load_bearing_two_source=false (9/23 corroborated), load_bearing_two_source_or_waiver=false (dual-source-OR-no-waiver required), prose_waivers_rejected=false (14 present). Missing inputs explicitly name '14 load-bearing constants lack a second controlled source' and '14 prose waivers require controlled evidence or removal'. Grants no citation-integrity, evidence-closure, batch-release, or regulatory authority under any input.
population: Five evidence_package candidate scenarios plus 3 fail-closed probes (wrong candidate_type=formulation, unknown module_id, whitespace module_id). Facts fixture is the on-disk 83-entry cited-constant registry (23 load-bearing including coating chemistry constants for DGEBA epoxy equivalent weight, polyamide amine hydrogen equivalent weight, MIL-DTL-24441 density anchors, ASTM D2471 gel-time thresholds, Wicks/Jones/Pappas 2007 §24 formulation identities). Source-records fixture is the 162-record public and controlled-source registry with 26 mandatory metadata fields per record.
split_methodology: No fitting - dual-source citation integrity is closed-form JSON parsing + count aggregation + boolean gate composition. The harness independently loads facts.json + source_records.json, counts (cited=83, load_bearing=23, two_source=9, prose_waiver=14, missing_url=0, source_record=162, incomplete=0), and asserts the runtime metrics/gates match bit-exact. The runtime's honest FAILED_GATES status is the primary deliverable: any regression that silently upgrades to SCORED without closing the 14-load-bearing-two-source-gap and 14-prose-waivers-gap trips the KPI. Byte-stability across replays is confirmed by comparing serialized ModuleResult payloads across five independent AssuranceCapability::evaluate invocations.
theory: ISO 690:2021 'Information and documentation - Guidelines for bibliographic references and citations to information resources' - the international framework for citation methodology that requires each substantive claim to be traceable to at least one identifiable, retrievable source. Association of College and Research Libraries (ACRL) Framework for Information Literacy for Higher Education (2016) - authority-is-constructed-and-contextual and information-has-value frames requiring dual-source corroboration for load-bearing claims. CRAAP Test (Blakeslee 2004, California State University Chico) - Currency, Relevance, Authority, Accuracy, Purpose evaluation methodology for source quality. PRISMA 2020 (Preferred Reporting Items for Systematic Reviews and Meta-Analyses; Page et al. BMJ 372:n71) - the systematic-review standard that requires dual-independent search + duplicate-source-verification for every included study. Cochrane Handbook for Systematic Reviews of Interventions v6.4 (2023) Section 5 (Study identification) and Section 7 (Risk of bias) - the discipline of never elevating a single-source claim into a load-bearing conclusion. Ioannidis 2005 'Why Most Published Research Findings Are False' PLoS Medicine 2(8):e124 - the empirical foundation for dual-source requirements in scientific claims. Nature 2013 editorial 'Reducing our irreproducibility' - single-source scientific claims are foundationally suspect. Anderson 1980 'Computer Security Threat Monitoring and Surveillance' - reference-monitor pattern applied to citation-integrity: a prose-waiver in a machine-verifiable ledger is a policy-bypass smell that must be surfaced.

metrics.name: facts_and_records_pinned_counts_rate
metrics.note: Independent recompute of facts.json + source_records.json: cited=83, load_bearing=23, two_source=9, prose_waiver=14, missing_url=0, source_record=162, incomplete=0. Any drift changes this count and fails the gate.

metrics.name: runtime_status_failed_gates_honestly_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, runtime returns status='FAILED_GATES'. Honest reporting: the ledger has 14 load-bearing constants without a second source and 14 prose waivers - any consumer that reads this status cannot silently treat the ledger as fully corroborated evidence.

metrics.name: runtime_score_zero_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, score_0_1 == 0.0. Zero score is the runtime's declaration that no citation-integrity authority is asserted.

metrics.name: runtime_metrics_pin_seven_counts_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates: metrics.cited_constant_count=83, load_bearing_constant_count=23, two_source_count=9, prose_waiver_count=14, missing_url_count=0, source_record_count=162, incomplete_source_record_count=0. All seven counts bit-exact.

metrics.name: uncited_constants_rejected_gate_true_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.uncited_constants_rejected == true (zero missing URLs). This is the one gate the current ledger passes: every cited constant has a primary URL.

metrics.name: load_bearing_two_source_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.load_bearing_two_source == false because 9 of 23 load-bearing constants have a second_url (14 gap). Honest reporting of the corroboration gap.

metrics.name: load_bearing_two_source_or_waiver_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.load_bearing_two_source_or_waiver == false. This composite gate requires both full dual-source AND zero prose waivers - a prose waiver in the ledger cannot substitute for a second controlled source.

metrics.name: prose_waivers_rejected_gate_false_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, gates.prose_waivers_rejected == false because 14 prose waivers are present in the ledger. Every prose waiver is surfaced; none are silently accepted.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_14_load_bearing_second_source_gap_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, missing_inputs contains '14 load-bearing constants lack a second controlled source' - runtime honestly names the exact count and gap.

metrics.name: missing_input_names_14_prose_waivers_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, missing_inputs contains '14 prose waivers require controlled evidence or removal' - runtime honestly names the exact prose-waiver count.

metrics.name: explanation_discloses_audit_only_load_bearing_gate_failure_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 candidates, explanations contain both 'audit-only' and 'load-bearing' - runtime explicitly discloses the module's Phase-0 posture and the failing gate.

metrics.name: authority_envelope_preservation_rate
metrics.note: For 5/5 serialized ModuleResult payloads, no key matches batch_release, release_authorized, qualified, authorized_by, manufacturing_qualification, or release_authority.

metrics.name: unsupported_input_fail_closed_rate
metrics.note: Three probes: (a) candidate_type='formulation' rejected via CapabilityError::CandidateType (module accepts only 'evidence_package'); (b) unknown module_id rejected; (c) whitespace module_id rejected. All three fail closed.

metrics.name: byte_stable_two_replay_rate
metrics.note: Observational. AssuranceCapability::evaluate invoked twice per candidate with identical inputs produces byte-identical ModuleResult (5/5).

fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.prediction_rule: For each evidence_package candidate: (1) load embedded facts.json via parse_json_strict, iterate entries; (2) count load_bearing (where v.load_bearing==true), two_source (load_bearing with non-empty second_url), prose_waiver (load_bearing with non-empty single_source_waiver), missing_url (entries with empty url); (3) load embedded source_records.json, iterate records, count incomplete (records with any required_record_fields value null); (4) evidence_complete = (two_source == load_bearing.len() AND prose_waiver == 0 AND missing_url == 0 AND incomplete == 0); (5) return ModuleResult with status='FAILED_GATES' (evidence_complete false) or 'SCORED' (evidence_complete true), score_0_1=(1.0 or 0.0), all 7 count metrics + 4 gate booleans + explicit missing_inputs enumerating the exact 14-and-14 gap + explanation citing audit-only and load-bearing gate failure. Runtime never inspects or elevates candidate-supplied evidence.
fitted_or_physical_model_artifact.note: Dual-source citation-ledger audit. No parameters to learn; the theory is ISO 690:2021 + ACRL 2016 Framework + CRAAP Test + PRISMA 2020 + Cochrane Handbook v6.4 + Ioannidis 2005 + Anderson 1980 reference-monitor for prose-waiver surfacing.
